shop/toml/razorpay.stable:
"# guard.toml for glow-salon-razorpay. Written by the Geometer deploy bundle: do not edit; change the shop's settings and deploy again.
# It holds no secret: the credentials are sha256 hashes, and the provider's key is read from a file only this Guard can read.
schema = 2
profile = "production"
# The runtime reaches the agent port on a network with no way out. The admin port stays on loopback; a forwarder in this Guard's network
# namespace gives the services that need it (ops, the relay, the token refresher) a way in, on a network the runtime is not on.
listen = "0.0.0.0:8080"
admin_listen = "127.0.0.1:8082"
health_listen = "0.0.0.0:8081"
deployment = "glow-salon-razorpay"
tenant = "glow-salon"
tool = "razorpay"
mode = "enforce"
upstream = "api.razorpay.com:443"
upstream_timeout_ms = 15000
state = "/var/lib/geo-guard/state.db"
bundle = "/etc/geo-guard/bundle.json"
bundle_digest = "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
unlisted_tools = "deny"

[[admins]]
id = "ops"
token_sha256 = "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"

[[agents]]
id = "runtime-glow-salon"
token_sha256 = "cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"
tenant = "glow-salon"

[[agents]]
id = "panel-glow-salon"
token_sha256 = "dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd"
tenant = "glow-salon"

[upstream_headers]
Authorization = "${file:/run/secrets/razorpay_authorization}"

[upstream_tls]

# Who may approve a held refund: the shop's owner, through the approvals relay, which signs each answer with the owner's secret (POST /admin/notify).
[[roles]]
id = "shop-owner"
tools = ["razorpay"]
operations = ["refund"]
rules = ["*"]
tenants = ["glow-salon"]

[[approvers]]
id = "owner-glow-salon"
roles = ["shop-owner"]

[notify_secrets]
owner-glow-salon = "${file:/run/secrets/owner_notify_secret}"
"
